verdict.rationale: LiteLLM proxy natively supports logging input/output/exceptions with call_id tracing to external observability stacks like Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, DataDog, S3/GCS/Azure Blob, Langsmith, MLflow, and custom callbacks/API endpoints. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of export reliability/completeness and no evidence of trace-sampling controls or guaranteed delivery guarantees.
